title: tvOS 27.2.1 update and HomeView Software 27.2 fix Bluetooth pairing bypasses and Brotli flaw CVE-2026-111497, which CISA lists as exploited.
content_md:
tvOS 27.2.1 update and HomeView Software 27.2 fix Bluetooth pairing bypasses and Brotli flaw CVE-2026-111497, which CISA lists as exploited.

via Mastodon https://securityonline.info/tvos-27-2-1-update-homeview-27-2/?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=jetpack_social

CVE-2026-111497.evidence: Event states CISA lists CVE-2026-111497 as exploited; Apple tvOS 27.2.1 and HomeView Software 27.2 fix the Brotli flaw.
